title: The Courtyard Welcome
story: James sat on the edge of a low stone planter, nibbling a corner of the dried sweet potato Sofia had given him. The courtyard was a world of quiet wonders, safely tucked away from the rumbling motor-carriages of Oakhaven's main streets. The scruffy dog Pippin snoozed contentedly at the young girl's feet, his tail giving an occasional lazy thump against the warm tiles. James felt a deep, grounding sense of peace settle over him as he watched the shadows shift across the blue-painted walls.
